audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Rune Prison a 'point-blank root' in five places. It is not a root by default.
audit.why: Rune Prison (W), 615 range on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, damages and SLOWS — it only roots if the target already has Flux on them. Spell Flux (E) at 615 on 3.5s down to 2.5s is what applies Flux, so the chain is E then W, and dodging the E turns his whole setup into a slow. Overload (Q) reaches 1000 and its cooldown is reset by his other basic abilities, which is why the flat 5s understates it. Realm Warp (R) is a 3000-range portal on 180/160/140s that teleports after a delay — a map tool, not a lane cooldown. Ryze has no dash, so Miasma's grounding does nothing here and its value is the slow.
audit.corrected: Flux-gates-the-root written into the chart, cooldowns, do's and the early/mid text; grounding downgraded to what it actually does in this lane.
